notes.title: About the play video release of "The Charming Empire"
notes.notes:
You are allowed to do so if you share the movie free of charge.
In that case, please let us know the URL after you upload the movie.

*All Visual novels are permitted , but The ending are not permitted.
*If it is for business purposes, you cannot do so unfortunately.

Thank you very much for your interest in our games.
